nodes.label: modifySchemaForSection
nodes.rationale: Strips the detectors schema default so RJSF does not merge {cpu:{type:cpu}} into stored detector keys, and injects a default genai provider; without this, opening a section falsely reports Modified.

nodes.label: modifyObjectsSchema
nodes.rationale: Promotes every tracked label (plus orphaned saved filters) from filters.additionalProperties to explicit properties so RJSF renders normal collapsibles instead of a key/value editor; sorted alphabetically to match the sibling track switches.

nodes.label: buildAttributeFilterSchema
nodes.rationale: Attribute filters expose only min_score/min_area/max_area because attributes never pass through _is_false_positive (no median-of-history check) and ratio tuning is not meaningful; int|float unions are flattened to number so RJSF omits the type-selector dropdown while the backend still accepts either.

nodes.label: getEffectiveDefaultsForSection
nodes.rationale: motion is anyOf [null, MotionConfig]; defaults are derived from the non-null branch so a stored null does not read as a pending change. detectors returns {} so schema defaults never add keys to the stored config.

nodes.label: synthesizeMissingFilters
nodes.rationale: The backend auto-populates objects.filters/audio.filters only at config init and not after profile merges, so the frontend synthesizes default filter entries for each label in the sibling list field (track / listen).

nodes.label: sanitizeOverridesForSection
nodes.rationale: Drops empty ffmpeg arg arrays, strips readonly detector model/model_path generated at startup, and dot-flattens logger.logs and environment_vars so nested UI objects serialize back into the flat YAML shape the backend expects.
